scripts.format: oxfmt -c ../vscode-extension/oxfmt.config.ts host.ts host.test.ts library.ts library.test.ts page.tsx app.css index.html package.json README.md
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check -c ../vscode-extension/oxfmt.config.ts host.ts host.test.ts library.ts library.test.ts page.tsx app.css index.html package.json README.md
scripts.lint: oxlint -c ../vscode-extension/oxlint.config.ts --deny-warnings host.ts host.test.ts library.ts library.test.ts page.tsx
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build && pnpm test
